messages:
Alex Rivera: quick heads-up — I'm onboarding Jordan (shadow) for the weekend on-call. Need to lock primary/secondary for Sat/Sun, call out any overnight coverage gaps, and drop the most important runbook snippets. Can someone update the rota? cc @Priya @Samir :wave:
Oncall Bot: schedule snapshot for 2025-07-12 to 2025-07-13 — Primary: Alex Rivera, Secondary: Priya Shah. No scheduled overrides. (use `/oncall swap` to change)`
Priya Shah: I can be secondary both days but i have a customer sync Sat 14:00-15:00 PT — so recommend swapping the 02:00-06:00 UTC overnight block if possible. Jordan should shadow the daytime primaries for the first pass.
Samir Patel: noted the overnight gap — I can pick up Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC if Priya covers the 14:00 sync. that keeps continuity. otherwise we have a 4h low-coverage window.
Joan Li: adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-shadowing — highlights to show Jordan:
- quick triage checklist
- how to read the routing table
- escalation matrix (Pager -> Slack -> Exec)
Also paste the essential commands below so Jordan can practice.
```
# check model-serving health
curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/_health | jq .
# basic restart of a worker (must be approved)
redwoodctl cluster restart-worker --id worker-03 --reason "test"
# escalate to SRE oncall via pager
pagerduty-cli incidents create --service "redwood-inference" --summary "urgent: p50 latency spike"
```
Alex Rivera: nice. for the shadow handoff do we want a warm call before the first page? propose a 30m pairing session Friday 18:30 PT where i walk Jordan through the typical incident flow and the KV-cache/eviction quick checks.
Jordan (shadow): 18:30 PT works for me. i'd like a short walkthrough of the graceful-degrade fallback policy (how routing falls back to quantized variants).
Priya Shah: i'll join the 18:30 pairing too. agenda: 1) quick triage 2) runbook nav 3) demo of `redwoodctl tail logs` 4) how to create a rollback canary.
Samir Patel: small note on runbooks — the latency playbook has the most recent run commands, Joan, can you confirm it's synced? last update mentioned `kv-cache` metrics under /metrics/kv_cache which changed last month.
Joan Li: confirmed — updated on 2025-06-30. i'll paste the relevant snippet in the runbook page and pin it in this thread. also adding a one-liner to the checklist: `check replica qps and tail error-rate > 5m`.
Incident Bot: test page sent to Alex Rivera and Priya Shah (this is a drill) :rotating_light: — please acknowledge with `ack` to verify paging reachability.
Alex Rivera: ack
Priya Shah: ack
Jordan (shadow): ack (received)
Samir Patel: ack — got it.
Alex Rivera: final confirmations then: Sat primary: Alex (Jordan shadowing daytime), Sat overnight 02:00-06:00 UTC: Samir covers, Sun primary: Alex, Priya secondary, warm handoff pairing Fri 18:30 PT. i'll update the rota now with `/oncall swap` and post the final schedule.
Oncall Bot: command accepted — rota updated. New assignment posted to rota channel.
Alex Rivera: checklist for handoff (quick):
- [x] rota updated
- [x] pairing session scheduled (Fri 18:30 PT)
- [x] Jordan added to PagerDuty as responder (temporary)
- [ ] runbook snippets pinned in thread (Joan to do)
- [ ] quick failover drill during pairing (run a simulated latency incident)
Joan Li: pin done — runbook snippet + KV metrics link pinned. also added the escalation Slack thread template: `/incident start --title "p50 latency spike" --template latency`
Samir Patel: will run the simulated drill during pairing and walk through the `redwoodctl` recovery steps.
Alex Rivera: thanks team — i'll follow up after the pairing with a short summary and any remaining gaps. Jordan, welcome aboard and see you Friday :tada:
Jordan (shadow): thanks all, really appreciate it — excited to learn!
